paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟，以检验其计算黏度的表现 [abstract][S1.p4]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在液相范围内较好地重现实验黏度，而经典势预测的黏度偏低 [abstract]。作者还发现，仅通过加热晶体结构，MACE-MP-0 模拟得到的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。作者认为，MACE 势所给出的动力学与经典势有定性差异，对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔融盐热物理数据，且此前 Buckingham 势对熔融 LiF 黏度的预测存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者因此转向机器学习原子间势，检验 MACE-MP-0 势计算 LiF 黏度相对于实验数据的准确性 [S1.p4]。其动机来自熔融盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂与燃料载体、热能储存等方面的应用需求 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Molten salts such as LiF have received long term and recent interest due to their use in solar cells, as electrolytes and solvents, and potential utilisation as coolant fluids in nuclear reactors, along with metals.
however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟，比较 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势 [abstract]。MACE 基于 Message Passing Neural-Network 架构，使用径向基函数与球谐函数构造消息，并采用高阶多体 ACE 展开进行消息传递，训练数据为 MPtrj 数据集（约 146,000 种材料、89 种元素，含 Li 和 F）[S2.p5]。两种 MD 方法均使用 N=512 原子体系，计算黏度时采用相同的最大关联时间 5 ps [S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride using the MACE-MP-0 (small) machine learnt interatomic potential and the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials.
The MACE model relies upon a Message Passing Neural-Network (MPNN) architecture where the input space is the dynamic local environment around any given atom along with its static properties
Messages are constructed with radial basis functions and spherical harmonics to encode known symmetries in physical applications.
the MACE model utilises higher-order many-body ACE expansion for message passing
The model is trained upon the MPtrj data set introduced for CHGNet and compiled from the Material Project dataset, which includes 89 elements (including Li and F) in $\sim 146,000$ materials.
For both MD methods we use the same maximum correlation time for calculating $\eta$, $5$ ps.
In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms

experiments.text: 作者将 MACE、BHM 与 Buckingham 势计算得到的黏度与 LiF 的实验黏度值进行对比 [S2.p3][S3.F1]。此外，作者还通过从晶体结构逐步加热的简单方法模拟熔点，并与实验熔点比较 [abstract][S3.p3]。在结构方面，作者分析了各势在各自近似熔点温度下的偏径向分布函数 g(r) 及其导出的结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: The viscosities calculated from Eq. 1 are compared to experimental values of viscosity.
Viscosity, $\eta$, from experimental results and calculated results using the MACE, BHM and Buckingham potential.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.
Next we look at the partial RDFs $g(r)$ in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.
We show $g(r)$ for each pair at the approximate melting temperature of each potential.

findings.text: MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在液相范围内较好地重现实验黏度，而经典势预测的黏度偏低 [abstract]。Buckingham 势的趋势正确但在温度轴上存在偏移，MACE 结果与实验结果吻合良好 [S3.F1]。仅通过加热晶体结构，MACE-MP-0 模拟的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。在结构上，MACE 的 g(r) 峰高略低于经典势、峰位略高，表明其模拟的配位环境比经典模型更宽 [S3.p5]。作者认为这些结果对“经典势熔点偏差导致黏度偏移”的假说提供了一定支持，但其他效应如体系大小和缺乏界面也可能有贡献 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
Whilst the previous predicted viscosities from classical potentials are under-predicted
As reported previously for LiF, the Buckingham potential has the correct trend but is off-set on the temperature axis.
The MACE results show good agreement with experimental results.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.
with the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.

limitations.text: 作者指出，从晶体结构逐步加热来确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件排除了实验中的自由表面与界面，且 MD 体系尺寸较小，缺少能促进熔化的长波长、低频声子；更可靠的方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。作者还说明，受计算时间和算力限制，无法用 MACE-MP-0 增大体系以扩展计算截断半径、观察 g(r) 更多峰并趋于 1 [S3.p5]。此外，作者承认虽然结果支持熔点偏差导致黏度偏移的假说，但体系大小和缺乏界面等其他效应仍可能起作用 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.
simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting.
This leads to the absence of long-wavelength and low-frequency phonons with large displacement amplitudes which destabilise the solid structure and likewise encourage melting.

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
